import_torch_module_to_graph: use TorchGraphImporter to import a PyTorch module and sample input into an analyzable graph
canonicalize_graph: call canonicalize on the imported graph to normalize its structure before scheduling
create_scheduler: instantiate a Scheduler with the graph to prepare for optimal scheduling computation
compute_optimal_schedule: call ComputeOptimalSchedule with a memory limit and swap options to get the best execution schedule
dump_graph_dot: call dump on the graph to output a DOT representation for visualization
